plain: The ancient past, especially ancient Greece and Rome

webster.text: Ancient times; former ages; times long since past; a very indefinite term; as, Cicero was the most eloquent orator of antiquity.

more.text: The ancients; the people of ancient times; as, the fact is admitted by all antiquity.
Ancientness; great age; the quality of being ancient; as, a statue of remarkable antiquity; a family of great antiquity.

example.quote: A project of this kind is little less romantic than the monster-taming spirit which is attributed to the fabulous heroes and demi-gods of antiquity.
